sloka: ततस्ते राक्षसेन्द्रेण चोदिता मन्त्रिणः सुताः ।निर्युयुर्भवनात्तस्मात् सप्त सप्तार्चिवर्चसः ।। ५.४५.१।।।।
transliteration: tataste rākṣasendreṇa coditā mantriṇaḥ sutāḥ ।niryuyurbhavanāttasmāt sapta saptārcivarcasaḥ ।। 5.45.1।।।।

translations.english: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of weapons, who were equally capable of conquering each other sallied forth gladly to fight with Hanuman. They drove chariots yoked with horses which were decked with golden mesh, holding totem staffs (a figure engraved to identify a hero) and flags, neighing like clouds. The valiant heroes were sporting and making sounds like stormy clouds wielding wonderful bows glittering like molten gold, shining like lightning. As they marched from the palace they looked like stormy clouds accompanied by lightning.
translations.hindi: भयङ्कर विक्रम सम्पन्न हनुमानजी, मेघनाद के उस बन्धन रूप कमं से विस्मित हो, क्रोध से लाल नेत्र कर, रावण को देखने लगे
